correction.prior_incorrect_claim: No direct Circle-SBI/SMFG relationship was established in the captured sources.
correction.corrected_claim: A direct Circle-SBI 50/50 JV for USDC distribution in Japan was established in 2025; SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank also invested USD25M each in Circle at its IPO. Circle's Q2 2026 SEC filing confirms Circle's 50% equity/VIE control, SBI's 50% noncontrolling interest, and no significant operating results through June 30, 2026.
correction.reason: Primary SBI releases, SBI investor presentation and Circle Q2 SEC filing re-examined after prior snapshot.
correction.scope: This corrects the Circle-SBI relationship; it does not establish a direct Circle-Ripple partnership or XRP use in the JV.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank each invested USD25M in Circle at its June 2025 IPO, USD50M combined.
SBI and Circle established Circle SBI Japan K.K. / SBI Circle Holdings as a 50/50 JV to support USDC distribution in Japan.

Circle's Q2 SEC filing confirms approximately USD1.5M-equivalent JPY contributed by each party in Nov2025; Circle controls/consolidates the VIE despite 50% equity; SBI is noncontrolling; no significant operating results through 2026-06-30.
Coinbase Q3 SEC filing says Circle arrangement renewed on same terms and average USDC held in Coinbase products reached an all-time high.
Circle Q2 SEC filing reports USD655.3M H1 and USD324.6M Q2 distribution costs under Coinbase agreements.
Coinbase Q3 stablecoin revenue USD306.905M vs USD324.534M YoY; higher balances +USD84.6M, lower rates -USD52.8M in Q3.
Circle Q2 average USDC circulation USD76.524B, end USD73.269B, reserve yield 3.5%, Coinbase daily weighted-average platform share 19.5%, end platform balance USD12.442B.
Approximately 84% of USDC reserves were in a BlackRock-managed Circle Reserve Fund at 2026-06-30; remaining reserves were bank cash.
Circle native USDC is on XRPL; Ripple native RLUSD is on XRPL; Coinbase distributes RLUSD on XRPL, Base and Ethereum.

sourced_claims.claim: Circle says H1 2026 USDC onchain volume exceeded USD36T, mint/redeem exceeded USD315B and USD819M paid for distribution partners/transaction costs.
sourced_claims.qualification: Gross onchain activity, not final payment settlement or new external capital.

sourced_claims.claim: Circle lists 38 native networks including XRPL and says BlackRock manages and BNY Mellon custodies the Circle Reserve Fund.
sourced_claims.qualification: Issuer disclosure; SEC filing independently confirms BlackRock management.

inferences.claim: SBI has direct financial exposure to both Circle and Ripple and a direct USDC-distribution JV with Circle, while its wider group also distributes RLUSD and XRP products.
inferences.basis: USD50M Circle investment, historical approx9% Ripple stake, Circle JV, SBI VC Trade distribution and XRP products. This is a multi-issuer strategy inference, not a unified settlement network.

inferences.claim: Coinbase is a common distribution node for USDC and RLUSD and an Open Standard/OUSD founder; multi-issuer expansion has not displaced USDC's strategic importance.
inferences.basis: Coinbase Q3 10-Q, Circle Q2 10-Q and RLUSD launch. Token-specific balances/revenue shares unknown.

inferences.claim: Circle's reserves link USDC economics to BlackRock-managed short Treasury/repo exposure and bank cash; SBI's separate BlackRock/JPYSC MOU is a shared manager link, not a common reserve pool.
inferences.basis: Circle Q2 SEC filing and SBI/Startale/BlackRock MOU.

inferences.claim: Native USDC on XRPL may increase ledger utility while reducing need for XRP as bridge in some USD/USDC transfers.
inferences.basis: Circle Mint/API native issuance and crosschain USDC functions; actual routing volumes unknown.

unknowns: Current Circle SBI Japan JV operating results and Japanese USDC balances after 2026-06-30.
Exact Q3 average USDC balance in Coinbase products; filing says all-time high but cited section does not quantify.
Why Coinbase Q2 average product balance metric does not directly reconcile to Circle's 19.5% daily weighted-average share/end platform balance.
Current Coinbase equity stake in Circle; Q3 filing confirms an investment but cited section does not give share count.
Circle Q3 reserve income, yield, USDC supply, distribution costs and Circle SBI Japan JV results; Q3 results not yet released at cutoff.
Token-level share of Coinbase stablecoin revenue and RLUSD/OUSD balances.
Share of USDC on XRPL used for payments, DEX, exchange transfers, DeFi or repeated transfers.
Whether any Circle/SBI stablecoin route uses native XRP as bridge or collateral.
Whether Circle's BlackRock reserve fund and SBI/Startale tokenized-MMF project ever share infrastructure beyond BlackRock.

disconfirming_evidence.claim: Circle SBI Japan K.K. had no significant operating results through June 30, 2026.
Coinbase Q3 stablecoin revenue declined about 5.4% YoY despite higher average USDC balances because lower interest rates offset part of the increase.
Circle says the relation between interest rates and USDC circulation is complex, highly uncertain and unproven.
No direct Circle-Ripple partnership or shared issuer arrangement is established by these sources.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI has a direct USDC distribution partnership and capital relationship with Circle, independent of its Ripple/XRP investments.
support: SBI and SBI Shinsei invested USD25M each in Circle at IPO.
SBI and Circle established a 50/50 Circle SBI Japan K.K. JV; Circle's Q2 SEC filing confirms each contributed approximately USD1.5M equivalent and Circle controls/consolidates the VIE.
counter: Circle's Q2 filing says no significant operating results through June 30, 2026.
The JV's purpose is USDC distribution; no XRP-specific settlement or custody is disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI is pursuing multi-issuer exposure, backing both Circle and Ripple while distributing USDC/RLUSD and XRP products rather than selecting one ecosystem.
support: SBI/SBI Shinsei invested USD50M in Circle and SBI historically disclosed approximately 9% Ripple ownership as of June 2025.
SBI operates the Circle JV, SBI VC Trade stablecoin distribution, XRP products, SBI Ripple Asia and owns bitbank.
counter: No integrated Circle-Ripple production route is disclosed.
The Circle JV had no significant operating results through June 2026; current Ripple ownership is not verified.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase and Circle remain economically interdependent even as Coinbase diversifies into RLUSD and OUSD.
support: Coinbase Q3 10-Q says Circle arrangement renewed on same terms and average USDC in products reached an all-time high.
Circle Q2 10-Q reports USD655.3M H1 and USD324.6M Q2 distribution costs under Coinbase agreements.
Coinbase discloses an equity investment in Circle.
counter: Coinbase distributes multiple stablecoins and Q3 stablecoin revenue fell 5% YoY.
Exact Q3 USDC balance and token-level revenue shares are not disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: USDC and Coinbase stablecoin economics are materially sensitive to reserve yields, while circulation growth can offset some rate compression.
support: Circle Q2 average USDC circulation grew 25% YoY while reserve return fell 66 bps to 3.5%.
Coinbase Q3 stablecoin revenue fell 5% YoY despite higher average balances; lower rates reduced Q3 revenue USD52.8M.
counter: Circle says the relationship between interest rates and USDC circulation is complex, highly uncertain and unproven.
Utility and distribution may support circulation independently of yield.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Circle and SBI have an indirect institutional overlap through BlackRock, but not a common reserve pool or direct Circle-SBI BlackRock transaction.
support: BlackRock manages Circle's reserve fund, which held approximately 84% of USDC reserves at June 30.
SBI/Startale/BlackRock signed a separate exploratory tokenized-MMF/JPYSC MOU.
counter: Circle is sole shareholder of its reserve fund; SBI's MOU concerns a separate project.
No common collateral pool or direct tri-party transaction is disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Native USDC on XRPL increases stablecoin utility but can substitute for XRP as bridge in some USD-denominated transfers.
support: Circle issues native USDC on XRPL and Circle Mint/APIs support direct mint/redemption and crosschain USDC movement.
RLUSD is also native on XRPL and Coinbase distributes both.
counter: No transaction-level routing data shows USDC replacing XRP in corridors.
XRP may remain useful for other asset pairs and settlement paths.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase is positioning as a multi-stablecoin distribution, custody and trading platform rather than depending on USDC alone.
support: Circle agreement renewed on same terms; Coinbase launched RLUSD; Coinbase is an Open Standard/OUSD founding partner.
counter: USDC remains economically material and average Coinbase USDC balance reached an all-time high.
No token-level balance/revenue split or RLUSD/OUSD displacement is available.
